text:
marta: quick thought — what if we let the per-node sidecars emit "implicit" degrade signals (latency spike, KV-cache miss surge) instead of central decisioning?
kevin: hmm, you mean sidecars vote to trigger an autofallback locally? :thinking_face:
ryan: can be faster but we lose a single source of truth for audit. how would we record who triggered what?
jess: maybe sidecars emit events to the audit pipeline with a short envelope, e.g. `{ source:sidecar-az1, trigger:kv_miss_rate, value:0.72, decision:degrade }` — lean but replayable.
marta: exactly. the UX question is how to surface that in the console without overwhelming operators. we need a concise trace and a way to jump from an operator notification to the full event stream.
kevin: proposal: operator inbox shows a compact card: time, service, reason, confidence, one-click expand -> shows last 30s of sidecar signals + rollout decision.
ryan: +1 but we need to tag these as "implicit" vs "explicit" decisions. implicit decisions should show the heuristic that ran on the sidecar. else it's 👻 when debugging.
jess: what about error triggers? sidecars might see downstream 5xxs and trigger degrade. should we require a threshold + cooldown?
marta: yeah, cooldown mandatory. also an optional operator opt-in: allow silent degrade (no user-facing notice) vs noisy degrade (alert paging).
kevin: UX mock idea: small toggle in rollout policy: "allow sidecar-implicit fallback" with sub-options: thresholds, cooldowns, notify-level. default off for account with SLA.
ryan: telemetry: we must surface per-decision breadcrumbs (which sidecar, signal sampling rate, model variant chosen) and a link to the replay query. can we reuse existing playback infra? ops-bot: deploy-bot says: we already index sidecar metrics under `sidecar.*` in trace-db, but we don't attach a decision_id by default.
jess: then add a small decision_id header to the sidecar emit flow. sidecar emits: `decision_id` when it makes a decision and that id is passed to the rollout API on fallback. that ties logs/traces.
kevin: UX for audits: timeline view with filter by decision_id, operator, service, reason. default view shows only escalate-worthy decisions. fine-grained view shows all.
marta: edgecase: split-brain where two sidecars disagree and flip-flop the fallback. we need hysteresis and global arbitration for conflicting decisions.
ryan: arbitration rule: local sidecar can request a fallback, but central arbiter can accept/reject based on global load. the console should show "requested by X, applied by Y".
jess: implementation note: sidecar should send a compact json via kafka topic `decisions.request` and central arbiter listens and replies on `decisions.response`. responses include `accepted|rejected|deferred`.
kevin: UI microcopy idea: when a fallback is applied, badge reads: "Auto-fallback — requested by sidecar-az1 — accepted by arbiter-1 (reason: kv_miss_rate)". clicking badge shows full event stream + play button for playback.
marta: last: operator override. allow sticky override with TTL and optional annotation required. console modal should require short reason.
jess: agree. also retention: keep audit events for 90 days by default, exportable as CSV/JSON for compliance teams.
ryan: security Q: do sidecars need extra perms to call rollout API? yes — mTLS + signer token per-node. audit should log signer cert thumbprint.
kevin: action items: 1) eng-runtime: add decision_id header and kafka topic (owner: jess, due EOW) 2) eng-platform: arbiter API sketch + audit schema (owner: ryan, due next Wed) 3) ux: mock inbox card + timeline view (owner: kevin, due next Tue) 4) security: cert thumbprint in audit (owner: sam — can we add sam to thread?)
marta: adding @sam for security sync. any objections to shipping a limited pilot for a single infra pool?
sam: (via ops-bot) sg. will check token/ttl constraints. prefer pilot behind feature flag + metrics-only mode first.
kevin: good call — metrics-only mode means sidecars emit requests but arbiter never accepts. we can exercise telemetry without impacting traffic.
marta: sounds like consensus. will sketch UX flows and an RFC. thanks all. :raised_hands:
ops-bot: NOTE: created ticked INFRA-1129 for sidecar decision topic.
